label: Critical finding
definition: Deficiency that causes a gate FAIL or defeats a Service Outcome tolerance.
gateEffect: A deficiency on a CRITICAL control or gate criterion: produces gate FAIL through the roll-up rule.

label: Improvement opportunity
definition: Criteria met; a practice could be strengthened.
gateEffect: No effect unless the control result changes.

label: Observation
definition: Condition noted without a criterion being unmet; no result effect.

label: Significant weakness
definition: Control result NONCONFORMING, or a deficiency in a SUPPORTING-mapped control requiring gate-level evaluation.
gateEffect: A NONCONFORMING result on a control relevant to a Service Outcome, or a SUPPORTING-control deficiency that required gate-level evaluation. Decision ≤ CONDITIONALLY_ASSURED for affected outcomes with a named, owned, time-bound condition.

label: Weakness
definition: A criterion partly unmet (control result PARTIAL) without gate effect.
gateEffect: Reflected in the control result (PARTIAL or NONCONFORMING on a non-critical control); listed in the decision record; no ceiling of its own.
